explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/133 with the negative answer to 'does f(n)/√n → ∞?' (Hanson–Seyffarth, Füredi–Seress). f(n) is the least possible maximum degree of a triangle-free diameter-2 graph on n vertices. Such graphs exist for all n ≥ 3 (e.g. stars), so the sInf is not the junk value 0 for large n.
